Seed swap day

Once a year, on the first Saturday of March, members bring the seed they saved and swap it for something they have not grown before. The day starts at ten in the hut and ends when the tables are empty. Bring your packets with the name of the plant and the year written on them, and take home as many as you brought.

Marsh Lane Allotments, 4 Marsh Lane. Open from dawn to dusk.
